incidents.name: VINU public addLiquidityETH with caller-supplied router
incidents.notes: VINU.addLiquidityETH(router, to, pair) was public and took the router address from the caller, so the attacker passed a fake router, moved the token side of the pair at will, synced the reserves and swapped the whole ETH reserve out.

sources.ref: onchain review: VINU 0xF7ef0D57277ad6C2baBf87aB64bA61AbDd2590D2 created 2023-06-06T10:46:47Z by 0x42b9b986e14be1483ecf5f2af7f713f2c6558d75 - 19.8 minutes before the incident - and that deployer is not the attack sender 0x9748c854... nor its funder; the deployer's own tx list shows it deploying VINU and adding liquidity, i.e. a genuine (very fresh) launch that was exploited immediately. No EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (1,188 seconds). Loss ~$6K per the PoC header, taken in ETH.
